scope: Only OpenSpec task 3.1: connect the existing persistent instrument session to the real native sampler processor, publish prepared mappings through its audio-reader gate, preserve coherent runtime/document/history across failure, state restore and host reconfiguration, and verify the actual native library graph. React transport, native undo exposure, WebView destruction/recreation, selected desktop/DAW acceptance and the complete beta remain pending.
red: The task-2.3 base failed to compile the native session consumer because the concrete C ABI, planar prepared-engine constructor and render-reconfiguration transaction did not exist.

The held-preparation native test initially failed with 'Host reconfiguration bypassed an admitted session worker'; prepareToPlay now blocks new structural admission, waits without holding reloadMutex, then reconfigures the newly accepted state.

The native facade repeat-prepare regression initially failed at completion because a second prepare consumed the Prepared enum state; the rejected second call now restores that state and the same job completes successfully.

Initial independent review failed the candidate because plugin-state restore could retain stale session state, restore could discard an active worker, publication called host notification code inside the reader-gated lease, and incomplete native callback tables could reach absent function pointers.
The exact publication-window test failed with 'Infallible session lease publication acquired a native mutex' before UI notification was moved beyond the lease.
The incomplete-callback Rust regression initially failed because completion incorrectly succeeded instead of retaining a terminal activation failure.

The second independent review found that post-restore prepareToPlay reloaded the original file instead of the edited embedded document. The strengthened native regression failed with 'Host preparation replaced the restored embedded edit with stale session or disk state'.

The first embedded-authority fix was intentionally broad and made the three existing engine/live handoff tests fail their -0.5 signed oracle with 0.25. The final source-authority flag limits embedded staging to restored documents, and all four focused handoff tests then passed.

native_host.consumer: The real Advanced Drum Kit sampler processor owns DandrumInstrumentSession, and its processor-owned async worker survives editor absence.
native_host.publication: C++ SessionActivation and EngineAccessPause RAII objects stage bindings and metadata, close audio admission, publish only the exact Rust-prepared engine and coherent revision/history, retire the old engine, then reopen admission. Parameter-surface notification follows after the native lease returns.
native_host.lease_contract: The C++ proof wraps pthread_mutex_lock and scopes same-thread counting to the exact committed publication callback. The repaired candidate acquires zero native mutexes in that window.
native_host.held_reader: A wrapped real processBlock render remains entered while mapping MIDI 36 to 60. The former engine is not destroyed while held and is destroyed exactly once after release.
native_host.signed_oracle: The accepted mapping renders literal -0.5 at MIDI 60 and literal 0.0 at MIDI 36. Activation rejection preserves literal -0.5 from the prior accepted engine.
native_host.metadata: Accepted YAML, prepared kit/kick UI metadata, revision 1, undo 1 and redo 0 publish together.
native_host.reconfiguration: 48 kHz block-size changes to 128 and then 256 preserve accepted YAML/history and signed output; a held mapping to MIDI 62 completes before the 256-frame rebuild, producing revision 2 and undo 2.
native_host.state_restore: A held mapping to MIDI 63 reaches its terminal outcome before concurrent plugin-state restore returns. Restore then retires the session and installs an edited embedded mapping at MIDI 62 while the original file still maps MIDI 36. Later prepareToPlay preserves matching YAML/UI metadata and -0.5 at MIDI 62; superseded MIDI 63 and original-file MIDI 36 remain silent.
native_host.source_authority: Only documents restored from embedded plugin state stage their retained YAML for later host preparation. Ordinary file-loaded instruments retain the established behavior of re-reading their source file.
native_host.callback_validation: An incomplete completion callback table is consumed as a retained terminal activation failure without changing accepted state. Duplicate completion is rejected, a later request is admitted, and incomplete reconfigure callbacks are rejected before state changes.
native_host.repeat_evidence: native-proof.log records the exact repaired PASS line and 10/10 repeat result

link_graph.assertion: Each product links the combined session archive exactly once, excludes the standalone engine archive, and resolves exactly one dandrum_instrument_session_create and dandrum_kernel_render definition.
